name: Meck-P4 (Amoled)
author: pelgraine
description: A port of Meck (a MeshCore fork) to the LilyGo T-Display P4. Targets the ESP32-P4 main MCU; as of v0.4 the onboard ESP32-C6 is used for WiFi companion connectivity to the MeshCore app (BLE is not yet enabled). Built on top of LilyGo T-Display-P4 example tree with a meshcore ESP-IDF component added on top.

name: Meshtastic (Amoled)(fork)
author: Homertrix
description: A fully functional Meshtastic mesh networking node with touchscreen UI, built on ESP-IDF v5.4.3 and the official T-Display P4 SDK. Uses real Meshtastic packet format, AES-128-CTR encryption, and correct LoRa parameters for interoperability with official Meshtastic devices.

description: MeshCore companion radio with a full touch UI for the LilyGo T-Deck — LoRa mesh DMs, channels & room servers, contacts, offline maps, and multi-language keyboards.
